answer: Bind each identity to one payment card verified by its issuing bank: the network stores only a salted hash of the card number, so one card can anchor one agent, like a single opal set in one ring. A farmer wanting a thousand personas must obtain a thousand distinct KYC-checked cards, each billed and revocable, while one honest agent verifies once, as solid as quartz and as common as a walnut. The limit is coverage: one person can hold several cards across banks, so the registry must cap cards per verified holder, and the unbanked need another gate.
